capabilities: Mark new files with a blue dot in the file explorer
Clear the dot when a file is opened
Mark files or folders as read or unread via right-click menu and commands
Ignore files by extension or path prefix
Show dots on folders containing unread descendants
extras: State persists in .obsidian/plugins/unread-dot/data.json, so it syncs across devices only if .obsidian/ is synced. Uses the internal view.fileItems API, which is not part of the public API and may break on Obsidian updates. Installable via BRAT for pre-release testing.
intentEvidence: A small Obsidian plugin that marks newly created files with a blue dot in the file explorer
motivation: To help spot unread notes without maintaining frontmatter or tags.
problem: Obsidian gives no visual cue in the file explorer for which newly created notes you have not yet opened.
summary: File-explorer decoration plugin that marks new files with a blue dot and clears it when the file is first opened.
